video_title: The Celtics Have Entered the Giannis Chat | Rachel Nichols & Chris Mannix

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Risks of the Celtics pursuing Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: if the Celtics do go all in to go get Giannis, I think it's a massive risk.
quotes.quote: If the Celtics do go all in to go get Giannis, I think it's a massive risk. I've been saying that for weeks now. Jaylen Brown is in his prime superstar. Top five, top six NBA player from last season, has won a championship there, has complemented Jason Tatum well, and has not had anywhere near the injury history that Giannis Antetokounmpo has.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.excerpt: it's a level of poker that only the best teams can play.

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: It's a level of poker that only the best teams can play. How much of a tweak do you make? The New York Knicks, we're going to get to Game 6 of the Eastern Conference Finals, but fire our coach because we think we're that close. We think it's that much of a tweak to make to then get to and win a title, and by the way, paid off. It's the little tweak of, okay, are we so good that we can just bring in a Jrue Holiday and get rid of a Marcus Smart or do the kinds of things that they did at the Boston level. When you're playing that level of poker, you're saying, okay, if we get to an NBA Finals and we're facing Victor Wembanyama, can we match up with that team? That is where Giannis comes into the equation. Then it's not a Jaylen Brown conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: Well, you're asking me, are you playing for that? If the question is, how do we win a title in today's NBA and are we good enough right now to do it given the level of competition, do you think that the Boston Celtics, as constructed, if they just sort of beef up their interior, but not Giannis beef up their interior, are they good enough?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' trade exception and need for a big man
quotes.excerpt: they've got a $27 million trade exception they can use. They can go out and find a big man.
quotes.quote: They've got a $27 million trade exception they can use. They can go out and find a big man. I don't know who it is right now. Maybe they make a run at Mitchell Robinson. I've been told Mitchell Robinson's medicals are not great. That's something to be wary of, and we've seen that. He has a hard time staying on the court for more than five, six minutes straight. Kristaps Porzingis is going to play 30-35 minutes to get Mitchell Robinson the other ones.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Why trading Jaylen Brown for Giannis is a mistake
quotes.excerpt: I don't think you trade Jaylen Brown for Giannis straight up, not given the concerns about Giannis's health.
quotes.quote: I don't love the deal for Boston because it's going to not only require Jaylen Brown, it's going to require other things too. It's probably going to require draft capital, maybe it's another piece that you've got to give up of your rotation that gives them up. I've said this before, I don't think you trade Jaylen Brown for Giannis straight up, not given the concerns that you have about Giannis's health.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Turner as a better fit than Giannis
quotes.excerpt: I would take Miles Turner on the Celtics team. I think that trade exception actually works.
quotes.quote: I would want Miles Turner from Milwaukee because I think there's a guy, if you want to talk about a guy you can just go get beyond Giannis. I would take Miles Turner on the Celtics team. I think that trade exception actually works. Now there's one off the top. Miles Turner would be a great fit in Boston. I would rather have Jaylen Brown and use that exception, you've used a draft pick to go get Miles Turner. I think that's a better team. Miles Turner, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, that's probably the favorite to win the East next year.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's leverage in team building
quotes.excerpt: He only wants to leave if he feels like he can't win a title with the Bucks.

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: I just want to flip to the Giannis side of this conversation, though, and this is more what I was saying about whether you're Jaylen Brunson, whether you're De'Aaron Fox, whether you're LeBron James, or now whether you're Giannis. What do you want? Giannis says that he does not want to leave Milwaukee just to leave Milwaukee. He only wants to leave if he feels like he can't win a title with the Bucks and he can win a title somewhere else. He has some power here, right? Because he will only sign an extension with the teams he decides to sign an extension with, and therefore those are the teams that could give up more assets to trade and therefore would be more attractive to Milwaukee.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: The singular focus of NBA superstars on winning
quotes.excerpt: If I'm Giannis, the only conversation I'm having right now, if I decide that I'm leaving Milwaukee, is where can I win?
quotes.quote: If I'm Giannis, the only conversation I'm having right now, if I decide that I'm leaving Milwaukee, is where can I win? Who's going to have enough left in the cupboard after this trade that I can win? How do I force myself to the place that I think is the absolute best? Give me all 29 other teams. Look at their their assets, look at who's going to be left on the court, look at whatever trade we think we can help orchestrate. Where can I win? What is the surest way for me to win a title?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Players taking less money for team flexibility
quotes.excerpt: I will take less money, you tell me what you're going to do with it.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: Especially the power that players can exercise is, okay, and I think LeBron might use this in the off-season, is like, I will take less money, you tell me what you're going to do with it. I'm not taking less money if you can put in your pocket and save yourself some tax penalties. You've got to use that flexibility to go get other pieces.

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: Yes, I mean there's a lot of power dynamics going on with the LeBron situation right now. We will consider taking less money if you come to me and tell me how you're going to use it is offering the construction that apparently this is his decision to make, whereas it's actually the Lakers' decision to make. But if I'm Rich Paul, of course that's the position I'm taking. I'm putting that out there.
